note: Phase 4 pattern-lens annotations. The lens is a reading aid, not a finding. Woodland Cottage and Accessible Garden Home use authored room polygons. Offset Stack, Courtyard Residence, Cross-Stacked Retreat and Solar Studio Stack use provisional room bands inferred from the model; their annotations are marked with geometry=inferred and must not be read as an authored layout. The common lodge has no interior room model, so its annotations are text-only (geometry=none).
